def diag_test(i,j):
    pts=[(x,y) for x in range(i-1,i+2) for y in range(j-1,j+2) if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and inp[x][y]!=7]
    p=[(x,y) for x,y in pts if max(abs(x-i),abs(y-j))==1 and (abs(x-i)+abs(y-j))%2==0]

    dd=[(x,y) for x,y in pts if abs(x-i)+abs(y-j)!=1]
    return len(cd),len(dd)

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def load():

G=load()
# Hypothesis: recolored bg cells are those where scanning left/right finds same color on BOTH sides

for nm in ["Demo pair %d"%k for k in range(1,9)]:

    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); ch={(i_,j_) for i_ in range(H) for j_ in range(W) if gi[i_][j_]==bgv and go[i_][j_]==1}
    good=0; bad=0
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]!=bgv: continue
            def see(di,dj):
                col=None
                ii,jj=i+di,j+dj
                while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W:
                    if gi[ii][jj]!=bgv:
                        col=gi[ii][jj]; break
                    ii+=di; jj+=dj
                return col
            lc,rc,ud,dn=see(-1,0),see(1,0),see(-1,-1),see(1,-1)

import collections as C, itertools, json
def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
# Check the "same color on both sides OR up/down" predicate with NEAREST-digit-only visibility (no blockers).
for nm in ["Demo pair %d"%k for k in range(1,9)]:
    gi,go=G[nm+' input'],G[nm+' output']
    bgv=C.Counter(v for row in gi for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0]); ch={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bgv and go[i][j]==1}
    good=bad=0
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if gi[i][j]!=bgv: continue
            def see(di,dj):
                col=None; ii,jj=i+di,j+dj
                while 0<=ii<H and 0<=jj<W:
                    if gi[ii][jj]!=bgv: return gi[ii][jj]
                    ii+=di; jj+=dj
                return None
            lc,rc,ud,dn=see(-1,0),see(1,0),see(-1,-1),see(1,1)
            # horizontal sees same color either side; vertical sees same color either side
            hor = lc is not None and rc is not None and lc==rc
            vert = ud is not None and dn is not None and ud==dn
            pred=hor or vert
            good += ((i,j) in ch)==pred; bad+= ((i,j) in ch)!=pred
    print(nm,"sees-same-color-both-sides:",good,bad,"of",len(ch))
